stock.description: Established in 1998 and based in Guangzhou, People's Republic of China, Times Neighborhood Holdings Limited specializes in delivering a broad spectrum of property management and related solutions. The company serves a diverse clientele throughout the PRC, encompassing property developers, individual owners, residents, and governmental organizations, managing both residential and commercial properties. Beyond its core property management offerings, the firm provides extensive value-added services to non-property owners. These include sales assistance, construction site support (such as consultancy and security oversight), real estate brokerage for residences, retail outlets, and parking facilities, as well as pre-delivery cleaning and urban renewal project management. For communities, Times Neighborhood offers public space leasing and efficient parking management. Residents benefit from a suite of personalized services like baggage handling, home refurbishment, asset advisory, communal group purchasing initiatives, and professional housekeeping. Furthermore, the company is involved in the complete lifecycle of elevator services—from sale and installation to repair and ongoing maintenance—and provides intelligent engineering solutions along with municipal sanitation services.
